items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tell him I heard that when Cornish swung at him, he'd run between his legs. [INTERVIEWEE] Say, heard that when Cornish swung at you, he'd run between his legs. Yeah.
